For those who run Linux, you can also block sites at the OS level by editing /etc/hosts, using iptables, or similar.
Literally just open the /etc/hosts file in an editor and it'll tell you what to do or do "man iptables" if you want that route.

Put this line in /etc/hosts :

127.0.0.1 siteyouwanttoblock.com

See http://linux.die.net/man/5/hosts for help on the syntax.
